text: “Am I not meant for you, papa?” Papa gave a quick, light laugh. “That doesn’t prevent it! I’m of the world, Pansy.” “Kindly permit us to retire,” said sister Catherine. “Be good and wise and happy in any case, my daughter.” “I shall certainly come back and see you,” Pansy returned, recommencing her embraces, which were presently interrupted by Madame Merle. “Stay with me, dear child,” she said, “while your father takes the good ladies to the door.” Pansy stared, disappointed, yet not protesting.
